learnings.title: Fed/FDIC/OCC/NCUA: third-party risk management guidance comment period extended to December 16
learnings.claim: Federal Reserve Board joint press release bcreg20261113a (13 Nov 2026; page read 2026-11-15) says FDIC, Fed, NCUA and OCC extend the comment period on proposed third-party relationship risk management guidance from November 16 to December 16. The guidance is principles-based and non-binding; when finalized, agencies plan to rescind existing TPRM guidance. The Fed separately extended to December 16 the comment period on a TPRM guide for Fed-supervised traditional community banks.
learnings.decision: REVIEW_ONLY: finance plan notes the Dec 16 deadline; no operational change without approval.
learnings.next_measurement: Record yes/no before 2026-12-16 whether any finance process depends on bank third-party risk guidance.

learnings.title: GitHub Copilot: six models deprecated on 2026-12-14 across all Copilot experiences
learnings.claim: GitHub changelog 2026-11-13 (page read 2026-11-15) says Claude Fable 5, Claude Haiku 4.5*, Gemini 3.8 Flash, Gemini 4 Argon, Grok 4.6 and Kimi K3 are deprecated across all Copilot experiences on 2026-12-14 (alternatives: Fable 5.2, Haiku 5.5, Gemini 4 Hydrogen, Gemini 4 Carbon, Grok 4.7, Kimi K3 TBA). *Haiku 4.5 stays for individual annual-plan subscribers. Enterprise/Business get alternatives auto-enabled unless the global default is off or the model is disabled.
learnings.decision: REVIEW_ONLY: system plan checks whether any cerniva workflow pins a deprecated Copilot model; no change without approval.
learnings.next_measurement: Record yes/no before 2026-12-10 whether any workflow pins a deprecated model.
